findings.detail: 364 ordinary pretty values are exact. Three proof-bearing maps use six native plus six staged true kernel comparisons and eighteen closed rfl/data proofs through a shared actual alias. Their twenty-one context checks are canonical propagation, not twenty-one direct native calls.

The first independent FS Def build failed because platform HS/Reflection had not yet been compiled. Its source/log/exit was retained; sixteen successful steps were hash-bound in the same fresh cache, and only remaining modules were compiled in actual import order.

Earlier successful executions had a visible Root proof-cache fallback. Actual findOLean probes selected all thirteen native and seventeen platform modules from the same independent cache, with every object hash-bound. After removing the fallback, five actual executions repeated both resolution probes, graph319, and both six-comparison/nine-rfl full-value environments. Earlier executions remain historical and are not relabelled as filtered or fresh. The initial IO/BaseIO probe failed with actual exit1 and is retained and excluded, as is the earlier environment final-gate failure.

The true R difference, actual Q=P/M^9 and root factor/quotient degree are proved under their original conditions. Aggregate inverse, kernel triviality, J and zeta(9) irrationality are outside this verdict.

n0 X4 has zero aggregate but is not Strong; Q is empty and weightedR(1)=1. The difference endpoint keeps Even, Strong and aggregate zero; the representation endpoint has no Even/Strong/zero premise and retains n>=1 and regular points.
